name: source-profile-module-resets
goal: Retain actual source observations across test module-cache resets without fabricating, replaying or mixing unrelated sinks

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The actual Reports handler run loses source observations after vi.resetModules because instrumented modules receive new collector instances while teardown flushes the original instance.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Extend the existing declaration-versus-runtime source-profile lifecycle test with two module resets and require one paired initialization observation per actual import; keep declaration collection empty.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Corrected sample-count corpus at 4c6f03b1d fails with [1,1] instead of [3,3]; exact red seal 45b411cd5915cc2cd5a02b327a6a53071e35923e2696bcfe84af63b721c02a0e.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Retain collectors across module resets, keyed by their original evidence directory and source runtime. Teardown flushes them without replay, cross-sink reassignment or successful samples for failures.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Retain collectors by evidence directory across module resets under the source runtime global. Original teardown flushes all instances; 24 collector cases pass without replay or benchmark instrumentation.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: At exact repair commit 6bce96168 all unchanged lifecycle cases pass, retaining [3,3] samples after two resets. Green seal aa62ce9516eaaef11c135a2eb3556a8377b054075a2fccd906e65c459a85c2a7 pairs red d526b8be519c79e8b34dd8d4816724b03c572793899d3efcf4f5a6feeb829de9.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: In an isolated Harness export of exact repair 6bce96168, reverting only profileRuntime to 4c6f03b1d fails [1,1] versus [3,3]. Restoring the repair passes seven unchanged lifecycle cases with empty source drift.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
